units.rawText: I never thought the forced activation of the combat module would damage the Professor's neural cloud to such extent...
units.displayText: I never thought the forced activation of the combat module would damage the Professor's neural cloud to such extent...

spans.text: I never thought the forced activation of the combat module would damage the Professor's neural cloud to such extent...

units.rawText: It was my design that caused this mess... I'm so sorry, Professor!
units.displayText: It was my design that caused this mess... I'm so sorry, Professor!

spans.text: It was my design that caused this mess... I'm so sorry, Professor!

units.rawText: Don't blame yourself, Croque, this wasn't your fault. It's but a mere consequence of my rash decision. Besides, if it hadn't been for your enhanced Sandbox Barrier and combat modules, our journey probably might have ended on that day.
units.displayText: Don't blame yourself, Croque, this wasn't your fault. It's but a mere consequence of my rash decision. Besides, if it hadn't been for your enhanced Sandbox Barrier and combat modules, our journey probably might have ended on that day.

spans.text: Don't blame yourself, Croque, this wasn't your fault. It's but a mere consequence of my rash decision. Besides, if it hadn't been for your enhanced Sandbox Barrier and combat modules, our journey probably might have ended on that day.

units.rawText: If only I could make the system more comprehensive... Sigh. Never mind, it's too late for that.
units.displayText: If only I could make the system more comprehensive... Sigh. Never mind, it's too late for that.

spans.text: If only I could make the system more comprehensive... Sigh. Never mind, it's too late for that.

units.rawText: Speaking of which, ever since I met you, Professor, I've been bombarded by your ridiculous orders, like suddenly asking me to expand the neural search radius and enhance the Sandbox Barrier, and I still had to prepare for a new alert system at the same time...
units.displayText: Speaking of which, ever since I met you, Professor, I've been bombarded by your ridiculous orders, like suddenly asking me to expand the neural search radius and enhance the Sandbox Barrier, and I still had to prepare for a new alert system at the same time...

spans.text: Speaking of which, ever since I met you, Professor, I've been bombarded by your ridiculous orders, like suddenly asking me to expand the neural search radius and enhance the Sandbox Barrier, and I still had to prepare for a new alert system at the same time...

units.rawText: Every single one of your orders was a challenge... Saving everyone... Saving the world... is more than just hard...
units.displayText: Every single one of your orders was a challenge... Saving everyone... Saving the world... is more than just hard...

spans.text: Every single one of your orders was a challenge... Saving everyone... Saving the world... is more than just hard...

units.rawText: Croque fiddles with her Metal Suit action figure, a deep sigh escaping her lips.
units.displayText: Croque fiddles with her Metal Suit action figure, a deep sigh escaping her lips.

spans.text: Croque fiddles with her Metal Suit action figure, a deep sigh escaping her lips.

units.rawText: Since my awakening, I've been endlessly drawn to movies and anime about mecha. Their stories of love, hope, passion, and bravery captivated me, sparking a dream that one day, that I too could become a Doll with a Soul of Steel.
units.displayText: Since my awakening, I've been endlessly drawn to movies and anime about mecha. Their stories of love, hope, passion, and bravery captivated me, sparking a dream that one day, that I too could become a Doll with a Soul of Steel.

spans.text: Since my awakening, I've been endlessly drawn to movies and anime about mecha. Their stories of love, hope, passion, and bravery captivated me, sparking a dream that one day, that I too could become a Doll with a Soul of Steel.

units.rawText: Being trapped in the Cloud, cast into exile... and feeling that desperate need to protect everyone—it all made me realize how much I was missing. Even now, that realization weighs heavily on me.
units.displayText: Being trapped in the Cloud, cast into exile... and feeling that desperate need to protect everyone—it all made me realize how much I was missing. Even now, that realization weighs heavily on me.

spans.text: Being trapped in the Cloud, cast into exile... and feeling that desperate need to protect everyone—it all made me realize how much I was missing. Even now, that realization weighs heavily on me.

units.rawText: Journeying to gain that Soul of Steel... it is a path so difficult, it crushes me underfoot... Saving everyone, saving the world... it's all just so hard.
units.displayText: Journeying to gain that Soul of Steel... it is a path so difficult, it crushes me underfoot... Saving everyone, saving the world... it's all just so hard.

spans.text: Journeying to gain that Soul of Steel... it is a path so difficult, it crushes me underfoot... Saving everyone, saving the world... it's all just so hard.

units.rawText: It's hard, yes. But isn't that exactly why you're pursuing it, Croque?
units.displayText: It's hard, yes. But isn't that exactly why you're pursuing it, Croque?

spans.text: It's hard, yes. But isn't that exactly why you're pursuing it, Croque?

units.rawText: ...Took the words out of my mouth, Professor. Way to steal my thunder.
units.displayText: ...Took the words out of my mouth, Professor. Way to steal my thunder.

spans.text: ...Took the words out of my mouth, Professor. Way to steal my thunder.

units.rawText: It's exactly as you said. Watching you move forward without fear, helping us build the Oasis bit by bit, seeing the sectors we've helped together...
units.displayText: It's exactly as you said. Watching you move forward without fear, helping us build the Oasis bit by bit, seeing the sectors we've helped together...

spans.text: It's exactly as you said. Watching you move forward without fear, helping us build the Oasis bit by bit, seeing the sectors we've helped together...

units.rawText: Ah~ I really want to be like you, Professor, someone who can protect everyone.
units.displayText: Ah~ I really want to be like you, Professor, someone who can protect everyone.

spans.text: Ah~ I really want to be like you, Professor, someone who can protect everyone.

units.rawText: Determination that never falters, bravery that stands firm, and kindness that knows no bounds—these are the virtues I've cherished in movies and anime. Professor, I'll carry that same spirit as I fight by your side in the battles to come.

units.rawText: Oh, I've got an idea! Let's rewatch some mecha shows! It might help you remember the times we binged it together... Let's kick it off with Metal Suit! No big deal, it's just 500 episodes or so!
